steps.title: Find the app you want to connect
steps.alt: App catalog with search and the three-step guide workflow
steps.caption: Search by app name or website. Seven guides are ready; other apps can be researched live. This prototype gives setup guidance—it does not run your agent or connect your accounts.

steps.title: Choose access and audience
steps.alt: Gmail read access for customers showing restricted-scope verification and a security assessment
steps.caption: The same app can have different requirements. Gmail read access for customers includes restricted scopes. The guide shows the effort, wait, approvers and next action.

steps.title: See what changes for send-only access
steps.alt: Gmail write-only view showing verification without a security assessment
steps.caption: Switch to Write: the restricted-scope assessment step drops out for send-only access. Changing these choices uses rules, so it does not spend research credits.

steps.title: Follow the next action and hand off clearly
steps.alt: Connection instructions with the contextual setup diagram, step ownership, code and copy controls
steps.caption: Steps identify what a person must do and what a coding agent can help with. The optional diagram sits beside the Composio configuration instructions and explains the setup a developer would perform outside this prototype.

steps.title: Check the evidence before relying on a guide
steps.alt: Expanded source list with Official, Tested and Inferred labels
steps.caption: Open the sources and unknowns. Tested means a dated observation from a setup attempt; it does not certify every scope or production approval. Most guides remain unreviewed.

steps.title: Research an app outside the catalog
steps.alt: Fresh Airtable research with completed identification and Composio lookup and source search in progress
steps.caption: A real Airtable run checked the toolkit and searched provider docs before writing and validating a guide. This is a captured live run, not an animation of a simulated result.

steps.title: Get a saved, shareable result
steps.alt: Airtable guide generated by the live research pipeline
steps.caption: That run saved seven steps with six sources and six open questions. It demonstrates generation and storage; Airtable account setup and approval have not been verified. Share links keep the selected choices, and JSON or Markdown exports support an agent handoff.

steps.title: Keep useful facts when research is limited
steps.alt: Airtable starter plan with an hourly-limit explanation, confirmed toolkit facts and a source link
steps.caption: Before the retry, the hourly cap produced this labelled starter. It kept confirmed Composio facts and a source link while leaving provider requirements unknown. A later retry produced the guide above. Library and saved guides remain available.
